name: micronaut-typescript-stdio
description: typescript client -> micronaut-hosted java agent over stdio, 7 steps

processes.name: client
processes.build: IT_ROOT="${ROOT}" MVNW="${MVNW}" ACP_VERSION="${ACP_VERSION}" CACHE="${CACHE}" TS_SDK="${peer.typescript-sdk}" ${ROOT}/programs/node/launch/build.sh && IT_ROOT="${ROOT}" MVNW="${MVNW}" ACP_VERSION="${ACP_VERSION}" CACHE="${CACHE}" ${ROOT}/programs/micronaut/launch/build.sh

comment: Hand-written, not generated: the acp-micronaut sample agent (an annotated @AcpAgent bean served by acp-micronaut, programs/micronaut) against the TypeScript client, over the catalogue steps a plain echo agent answers. stdio.eof-exit checks that the Micronaut application exits when its input ends.
